title: Ezra Loves the Scriptures
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders, and tonight Ezra sets his heart to study Heavenly Father’s words: when everyone at story time rushes to the next page, Wren stops to ask what that part meant, reads it again, and finds something wonderful.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she slows down to let good things sink in. In Wren’s world today: at story time, everyone was rushing to the next page, but Wren wanted to stop and think. “Wait — what did that part mean?” she wondered. She read it again and found something wonderful. Just like Ezra, who set his heart to study Heavenly Father’s words, Wren learned that pondering slowly helps the good things stay in your heart.
